Container.Name: ahoy
Container.Overview: Ahoy is the player-facing side of your game server: accounts, friends, what everyone is playing, discovery (Steam storefront, Metacritic lists), and the desktop launcher that installs and plays games. The finding, downloading and preparing is done by ludarr, which Ahoy connects to.
Container.Description: The player-facing Ahoy server: accounts, friends, discovery, the launcher. The first person to sign up runs the server and connects it to ludarr from the web UI.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: database, art cache, the published launcher

Config.Name: ludarr address
Config.Description: optional: pin the ludarr server here instead of entering it in the web UI

Config.Name: ludarr API key
Config.Description: optional, goes with the address above

Config.Name: Card cut-outs
Config.Description: on: the Home's cards cut their subject out (a 973 MB model, downloaded once; about 7.5 GB of RAM while it works). off: no model, every card a dissolve
